hero.label: About
hero.title: We're a technical product studio.
hero.description: Dreeeams builds digital systems that companies rely on — web platforms, mobile apps, backend infrastructure, and automation. Based in Bogotá, working globally.

items.description: We define scope before we write code. Every project starts with a clear objective, a defined timeline, and an honest budget.
Ideas don't ship themselves. Our value is in the build — reliable, tested, production-grade systems delivered on time.
We don't build pages. We build architectures that scale, integrate, and evolve with your business.
We're not vendors. We embed with your team, think long-term, and stay accountable after launch.
Every design decision maps to a business outcome. No decoration without purpose, no features without strategy.
Next.js, React Native, Node, PostgreSQL, Redis, AI pipelines. We own the full stack, top to bottom.

steps.title: Scope
steps.description: We start with a call. Define the problem, the goal, and the constraints. No proposal until we understand the build.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.description: We design the system before the screens. Data models, API structure, integrations, deployment strategy.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Iterative sprints with clear deliverables. You see progress weekly, not monthly. Every decision documented.

steps.title: Launch & evolve
steps.description: We deploy, monitor, and iterate. Most clients continue with us for ongoing improvements and new features.
